author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have successfully used CAR-T cell therapy to induce complete remission in a patient suffering from three severe autoimmune diseases by targeting and eliminating rogue B cells. This treatment effectively resets the immune system, offering new hope for tackling chronic autoimmune conditions.

Source Article: https://www.cell.com/med/fulltext/S2666-6340(26)00078-4
